name: Mycolith
ability: Paleomycelium (its own: Grass moves get STAB; immune to Leech Seed, powder and spore moves) / Effect Spore (hidden)
look: a stout weathered stone pillar like a petrified stump with rings on its flat top, glowing purple and amber mycelium in its cracks, glowing spore eyes in a hollow near its base and root tendrils
entry: Revived from the Spire Fossil. Over 400 million years ago, fields of Mycolith dominated the barren land before true trees ever took root. Researchers originally mistook its fossilized remains for ancient timber.
how: Revive a Spire Fossil at a Restoration Tank. Spire Fossils are found by brushing the suspicious gravel round petrified spire stumps in forests and swamps.
